import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MX = 20;
    static final int MXN = 400;
    static final int MXE = 200000;
    static final int INF = 199999999;

    static int[][] board = new int[MX][MX];
    static int[] dist = new int[MXN];
    static int[] q = new int[MXN];
    static int[] inq = new int[MXN];
    static int[][] adj = new int[MXN][MXN];
    static int n, nodes, T;
    static String line;
    static int zx, zy;
    static int[] dx = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] dy = {-1, 1, 0, 0};

    static class Edge {
        int u, v, cap, nxt;
        Edge(int u, int v, int cap, int nxt) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.nxt = nxt;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] e = new Edge[MXE];
    static int[] h = new int[MXN];
    static int ecnt, s, t;
    static List<int[]> H = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<int[]> R = new ArrayList<>();

    static int idx(int r, int c) {
        return (r - 1) * n + c;
    }

    static boolean oob(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 1 && r <= n && c >= 1 && c <= n && board[r][c] != -1;
    }

    static void init_graph() {
        nodes = n * n;
        for (int i = 0; i < MXN; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(adj[i], -1);
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= n; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= n; ++c) {
                if (board[r][c] == -1) continue;
                int u = idx(r, c);
                adj[u][u] = 0;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nr = r + dx[k], nc = c + dy[k];
                    if (oob(nr, nc)) {
                        int v = idx(nr, nc);
                        adj[u][v] = 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void spfa_src() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; ++i) dist[i] = INF;
        int f = 0, r = 0;
        int st = idx(zx, zy);
        dist[st] = 0;
        q[r++] = st;
        while (f < r) {
            int u = q[f++];
            for (int v = 1; v <= nodes; ++v) {
                if (adj[u][v] == 1 && dist[v] > dist[u] + 1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void floyd() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= nodes; ++k)
            for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; ++i)
                for (int j = 1; j <= nodes; ++j)
                    if (adj[i][k] != -1 && adj[k][j] != -1)
                        if (adj[i][j] == -1 || adj[i][j] > adj[i][k] + adj[k][j])
                            adj[i][j] = adj[i][k] + adj[k][j];
    }

    static void build_flow() {
        Arrays.fill(h, -1);
        ecnt = 0;
        s = 0;
        t = H.size() + R.size() + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < H.size(); ++i) {
            int cnt = H.get(i)[2];
            e[ecnt] = new Edge(s, i + 1, cnt, h[s]);
            h[s] = ecnt++;
            e[ecnt] = new Edge(i + 1, s, 0, h[i + 1]);
            h[i + 1] = ecnt++;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < R.size(); ++i) {
            int cnt = R.get(i)[2];
            e[ecnt] = new Edge(H.size() + i + 1, t, cnt, h[H.size() + i + 1]);
            h[H.size() + i + 1] = ecnt++;
            e[ecnt] = new Edge(t, H.size() + i + 1, 0, h[t]);
            h[t] = ecnt++;
        }
        int src_pos = idx(zx, zy);
        for (int i = 0; i < H.size(); ++i) {
            int hr = H.get(i)[0], hc = H.get(i)[1];
            int hp = idx(hr, hc);
            for (int j = 0; j < R.size(); ++j) {
                int rr = R.get(j)[0], rc = R.get(j)[1];
                int rp = idx(rr, rc);
                if (adj[hp][rp] != -1 && adj[hp][rp] <= T) {
                    if (adj[hp][rp] < dist[rp]) {
                        e[ecnt] = new Edge(i + 1, H.size() + j + 1, INF, h[i + 1]);
                        h[i + 1] = ecnt++;
                        e[ecnt] = new Edge(H.size() + j + 1, i + 1, 0, h[H.size() + j + 1]);
                        h[H.size() + j + 1] = ecnt++;
                    } else if (adj[hp][rp] == dist[rp]) {
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nr = rr + dx[d], nc = rc + dy[d];
                            if (oob(nr, nc)) {
                                int np = idx(nr, nc);
                                if (adj[hp][np] == adj[hp][rp] - 1 && adj[hp][np] < dist[np]) {
                                    e[ecnt] = new Edge(i + 1, H.size() + j + 1, INF, h[i + 1]);
                                    h[i + 1] = ecnt++;
                                    e[ecnt] = new Edge(H.size() + j + 1, i + 1, 0, h[H.size() + j + 1]);
                                    h[H.size() + j + 1] = ecnt++;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] lvl = new int[MXN];
    static int[] q2 = new int[MXN];

    static boolean bfs_dinic() {
        Arrays.fill(lvl, -1);
        int f = 0, r = 0;
        q2[r++] = s;
        lvl[s] = 0;
        while (f < r) {
            int u = q2[f++];
            for (int i = h[u]; i != -1; i = e[i].nxt) {
                int v = e[i].v;
                if (lvl[v] == -1 && e[i].cap > 0) {
                    lvl[v] = lvl[u] + 1;
                    if (v == t) return true;
                    q2[r++] = v;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dfs_dinic(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == t) return flow;
        for (int i = h[u]; i != -1; i = e[i].nxt) {
            int v = e[i].v;
            if (lvl[v] == lvl[u] + 1 && e[i].cap > 0) {
                int pushed = dfs_dinic(v, Math.min(flow, e[i].cap));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e[i].cap -= pushed;
                    e[i ^ 1].cap += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int maxflow() {
        int flow = 0;
        while (bfs_dinic()) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= t; ++i) h[i] = -1;
            System.arraycopy(h, 0, h, 0, h.length);
            int f;
            while ((f = dfs_dinic(s, INF)) > 0) flow += f;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static int solve() {
        board[zx][zy] = 0;
        init_graph();
        spfa_src();
        board[zx][zy] = -1;
        init_graph();
        floyd();
        build_flow();
        return maxflow();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        H.clear();
        R.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MX; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(board[i], 0);
        }
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (line.charAt(j) == 'Y') board[i][j + 1] = -1;
                else if (line.charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j + 1;
                    board[i][j + 1] = -1;
                } else if (line.charAt(j) > '0' && line.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    H.add(new int[]{i, j + 1, line.charAt(j) - '0'});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (line.charAt(j) > '0' && line.charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    R.add(new int[]{i, j + 1, line.charAt(j) - '0'});
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(solve());
    }
}
